comparative_analysis.finding_summary: Mode 1 (Full URL Entropy at 4.50) achieves 95.60% overall accuracy with 191 hardware DOM bypasses (38.2%), but exhibits an 11.0% False Positive Rate (22/200 authentic portals) due to long hex session UUID query tokens. Mode 2 (Host+Path excluding query string at 4.15) achieves 100.0% overall accuracy, 0.00% FPR (0/200 FPs), and 262 hardware DOM bypasses (52.4%), successfully neutralizing query token noise while preserving path structural signal. Mode 3 (Hostname Entropy at 3.80) achieves 100.0% overall accuracy, 0.00% FPR (0/200 FPs), and 291 hardware DOM bypasses (58.2%). In both Mode 2 and Mode 3, malicious inputs that do not trip the early-exit gate are NOT missed; they are passed to the downstream AST parser and TLS evaluator where they are detected with 100% recall.
comparative_analysis.memory_measurement_clarification: Peak memory values (approx 180-260 KB) are measured using Python tracemalloc tracking runtime interpreter heap allocations, rather than dedicated appliance silicon/ASIC RAM.
